commands.name: history
commands.title: History
commands.description: View wallpapers you selected or downloaded

commands.name: auto-switch-wallpaper
commands.title: Auto Switch Wallpaper
commands.description: Switch wallpapers automatically on a schedule

preferences.name: refreshIntervalSeconds
preferences.title: Refresh Interval
preferences.description: How often the wallpaper should change in the background.

preferences.name: notifyOnSwitch
preferences.title: Notification
preferences.label: Show HUD when wallpaper changes
preferences.description: Display a brief on-screen notice with the artwork title each time the wallpaper changes in the background.

tools.name: search-wallpaper-history
tools.title: Search Wallpaper History
tools.description: Search saved history by artwork words, artist, creation year, usage date range, or action type. Returns unique artworks and their matching events, newest first.

tools.name: set-wallpaper-from-history
tools.title: Set Wallpaper from History
tools.description: Set a previously used artwork as the desktop wallpaper using its exact wallpaper ID from history search or listing. Records a new selection in history.

tools.name: get-todays-wallpapers
tools.title: Get Today's Wallpapers
tools.description: Get today's featured artwork and two alternative wallpapers with their details. Does not change the desktop wallpaper.

tools.name: get-random-wallpaper
tools.title: Get Random Wallpaper
tools.description: Get a random artwork with its wallpaper details. Does not change the desktop wallpaper.

tools.name: get-wallpaper-history
tools.title: Get Wallpaper History
tools.description: Get previously selected, downloaded, and automatically switched wallpapers, grouped by artwork with every action and timestamp, newest first.

tools.name: set-wallpaper
tools.title: Set Wallpaper
tools.description: Set an artwork as the desktop wallpaper and record it in history. Use wallpaper details returned by the browsing or history tools.

tools.name: download-wallpaper
tools.title: Download Wallpaper
tools.description: Save an artwork to the Downloads folder and record it in history. Use wallpaper details returned by the browsing or history tools. Does not change the desktop wallpaper.
